description_en: Retrieves the details of a VPC firewall for a transit router
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-tr-firewalls-v2-detail --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-a5a6b89f467649280000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrFirewallsV2Detail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC firewall instance. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the error ErrorMissingFirewallId (-360444, firewall id is required) is returned.

You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to query existing FirewallId values (in the format of vfw-tr-*). If no firewall has been created, create an Enterprise Edition transit router in the CEN console first, and then call CreateTrFirewallV2
parameters.help_zh:
VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。本参数必填，缺失时返回 ErrorMissingFirewallId（-360444，firewall id is required）。

可通过 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 查询已有的 FirewallId（格式为 vfw-tr-*）；若尚未创建，需先在 CEN 产品中创建企业版转发路由器，再调用 CreateTrFirewallV2
parameters.name: firewall_id

CenId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)

FirewallAttachmentZone.description_en: The zone ID used by the firewall connection
FirewallAttachmentZone.description_zh: 防火墙连接使用的可用区 ID

FirewallEniId.description_en: The ID of the firewall ENI

FirewallEniVpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the firewall ENI belongs
FirewallEniVpcId.description_zh: 防火墙ENI 所在的VPC ID

FirewallEniVswitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the firewall ENI belongs
FirewallEniVswitchId.description_zh: 防火墙ENI 所在的VSWITCH ID

FirewallId.description_en: The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls

FirewallName.description_en: The instance name of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls

FirewallServiceMode.description_en: The deployment mode of the VPC firewall for the transit router. Valid values: PrimaryStandby (active/standby mode) and MultiPrimary (active-active mode)
FirewallServiceMode.description_zh: TR 防火墙服务部署模式。 取值：PrimaryStandby（主备模式）、MultiPrimary（双活模式）

FirewallServiceZones.description_en: The list of zone IDs used by the VPC firewall for the transit router
FirewallServiceZones.description_zh: TR 防火墙服务使用的可用区 ID 列表

items.description_en: The zone ID used by the VPC firewall for the transit router
items.description_zh: TR 防火墙服务使用的单个可用区 ID

FirewallStatus.description_en:
The status of the firewall. Valid values:

Creating: The firewall is being created.

Deleting: The firewall is being deleted.

Ready: The firewall is ready
FirewallStatus.description_zh:
防火墙状态。取值：

Creating：创建中

Deleting：删除中

Ready：就绪

FirewallSubnetCidr.description_en: The subnet CIDR block that stores the firewall ENI in the firewall VPC in automatic mode
FirewallSubnetCidr.description_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中存放防火墙ENI的子网网段

FirewallSwitchStatus.description_en:
The status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Valid values:

opened: enabled.

closed: disabled.

notconfigured: the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls are not configured.

configured: the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls are configured but not enabled.

creating: the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls are being created.

opening: the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls are being enabled.

deleting: the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls are being deleted.


If this parameter is not set, virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls in all states are queried
FirewallSwitchStatus.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：

opened：已开启

closed：已关闭

notconfigured：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙

configured：表示已配置VPC边界防火墙

creating：表示正在创建VPC边界防火墙

opening：表示正在开启VPC边界防火墙

deleting：表示正在删除VPC边界防火墙


不设置该参数表示查询所有状态的VPC边界防火墙

FirewallVpcCidr.description_en: The CIDR block of the firewall VPC in automatic mode
FirewallVpcCidr.description_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC网段

RegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the transit router instance
RegionNo.description_zh: 转发路由器实例I的地域ID

RouteMode.description_en:
The routing mode. Valid values:

manual: manual mode
RouteMode.description_zh:
路由模式。取值：

manual：表示手动模式

TrAttachmentMasterZone.description_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中用于连接TR的子网主用可用区

TrAttachmentSlaveCidr.description_en: The secondary subnet CIDR block used to connect the firewall VPC to the transit router in automatic mode
TrAttachmentSlaveCidr.description_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中用于连接TR的子网备用网段

TrAttachmentSlaveZone.description_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中用于连接TR的子网备用可用区

TrAttachmentZones.description_en: The list of zones and vSwitch CIDR blocks for the transit router connection
TrAttachmentZones.description_zh: TR 连接可用区及交换机网段信息列表

VSwitchCidr.description_en: The CIDR block of the vSwitch for the transit router connection
VSwitchCidr.description_zh: TR 连接交换机的网段
